subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Should this umbrella remain open as the browser/search evaluation tracker, or should maintainers split and close it after moving the remaining Lightpanda, search-stack, and security-boundary work into narrower issues?
rationale: The request spans product direction, browser sandbox security, search-provider behavior, and benchmark methodology; current source proves overlap with several open issues but not one completed or canonical replacement.

options.title: Split Into Scoped Issues
options.body: Preserve the useful context and split concrete work into separate browser backend, browser-backed extraction, search-provider hardening, and benchmark-matrix tasks.

options.title: Keep As Evaluation Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as a maintainer-owned matrix and security-review tracker until the Lightpanda/tool-health study is written down.

options.title: Close Into Existing Browser Issues
options.body: Close this only if maintainers decide the search-stack matrix is no longer needed and move any remaining context into the open related browser issues.

recommendation.title: Split Into Scoped Issues
recommendation.body: Preserve the useful context and split concrete work into separate browser backend, browser-backed extraction, search-provider hardening, and benchmark-matrix tasks.

likelyOwner.reason: The browser plugin boundary, sandbox browser hardening, and web-tool split history point most strongly to this account for product-scope routing.
